Question B-007-004-005.

Why the correct answer is right: One-hop and two-hop components can arrive with changing phase relationships as the ionosphere moves. Those changing additions and cancellations produce variations in received signal strength.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "Consistently weaker signals": Multipath does not only reduce strength; the components can cancel at some moments and reinforce at others.
- sourceIndex 2: "Consistently stronger signals": A steady improvement is not expected when changing paths are sometimes out of phase.
- sourceIndex 3: "A shift in signal frequency": The main effect here is fading in amplitude, not moving the transmitted signal to another frequency.
